desc: Ideation: identified heap-based best-first selection on monotone 3D grid as the right approach (K ≤ 5·10⁵ makes O(K log K) feasible); rejected O(N²)-per-check binary search counting as too slow.

Implement the heap-based K-th largest selection: sort A, B, C descending; max-heap seeded with (0,0,0); pop K times pushing forward neighbors with visited set; output K-th popped value; fast I/O via sys.stdin.buffer.

Validate correctness argument (frontier expansion guarantees pops in descending order even with duplicates) and test on samples plus edge cases: N=1, K=1, K=N³, all-equal arrays, max values (10⁹) for performance; cross-validate with brute force for small N.
